test_strategy: Adopt a hybrid test approach combining automated unit, integration, E2E, performance, and security testing. Utilize pytest for backend unit tests (Python SDK, Redis adapter, Feast integration), Spark testing frameworks for batch jobs, Locust or JMeter for latency and load validation, and OWASP ZAP for security scanning. Infrastructure validation through Terraform testing, plus Databricks job verification scripts. CI/CD integrated with GitHub Actions to run tests and report coverage.

test_cases.title: Feature registration stores correct metadata and version in Feast registry
test_cases.description: Verify registering a feature via API saves version, metadata, and lineage in Feast registry.
steps: Query Feast registry for registered feature
test_cases.expected_result: Feature appears in registry with correct name, version, owner, and lineage metadata.

test_cases.title: Batch feature computation runs successfully and updates Delta tables
test_cases.description: Ensure Spark job computes features without duplication and updates Delta tables with fresh data.
steps: Trigger daily Spark job on Databricks
Query Delta table after job completion
test_cases.expected_result: Delta table contains updated feature values with current timestamp and no duplicates.

test_cases.title: Real-time feature serving latency under 10ms for 50 concurrent requests
test_cases.description: Validate that Redis-based feature serving meets latency SLA under load.
steps: Send 50 parallel GET requests for existing features
test_cases.expected_result: Each response returned in <10ms at p99 latency threshold.

test_cases.title: Point-in-time joins retrieve correct historical feature values for training data
test_cases.description: Verify that training data retrieval through Feast produces temporally accurate feature values.
steps: Execute Feast get_historical_features call with timestamps
test_cases.expected_result: Each feature corresponds to values available before event timestamp (no leakage).

test_cases.title: Feature drift detection triggers alert for significant deviation
test_cases.description: Confirm drift detection mechanism identifies statistical drift and generates alerts.
steps: POST to /api/features/monitoring/report with large mean difference
test_cases.expected_result: Response includes drift_detected = true and alert_id assigned.

test_cases.title: Unity Catalog enforces team-based access control for feature retrieval
test_cases.description: Ensure only authorized teams can read/write features per access level.
steps: Try to access feature without required permission
test_cases.expected_result: Unauthorized access denied (401), authorized access succeeds.

test_cases.title: API returns error for invalid registration payloads
test_cases.description: Check input validation and error handling for malformed feature registration requests.
test_cases.expected_result: Returns HTTP 422 or 400 with validation error message; no registry update performed.

test_cases.title: SDK retrieves feature values via Feast correctly
test_cases.description: Validate SDK client fetches correct features using Feast repository for online and historical data.
preconditions: Feast client configured to correct repo path
steps: Invoke FeastClient.get_features() with valid entity_ids and feature_names
test_cases.expected_result: Feature data returned matches values stored in offline/online stores with correct timestamps.

test_cases.title: Redis adapter warns latency breach and handles missing feature gracefully
test_cases.description: Ensure RedisAdapter logs latency warnings >10ms and raises exception when feature not found.
test_cases.expected_result: Exception raised for missing feature; warning logged when latency exceeds threshold.

test_cases.title: Infrastructure deployment scripts create consistent environments across stages
test_cases.description: Validate Terraform scripts produce identical configurations in dev/stage/prod with Feast and Redis instances.
steps: Run terraform apply on each environment
test_cases.expected_result: Identical configuration applied; all services operational and verified by health checks.

test_data_requirements: Sample transaction dataset with customer_id, amount, timestamp
Historical event logs for point-in-time join validation
Offline and online feature statistics with simulated drift conditions
Team-role mapping for Unity Catalog access control
Feature registration payloads with valid and invalid combinations
automation_approach: Automation implemented via pytest for unit/integration tests, Databricks notebooks for batch job validation, and Locust for load testing the FastAPI endpoints. CI pipeline in GitHub Actions runs tests automatically on each commit. Integration tests mock Redis and Feast connections using pytest fixtures. Security and access tests integrated with OAuth2 token simulation. Performance data recorded through Prometheus exporters and analyzed post-test.
coverage_goals: Achieve 90% unit test coverage on Python SDK and API modules, 85% integration coverage across Feast, Databricks, Redis interactions, 100% test execution for critical user stories (registry, serving, joins, monitoring), and p99 latency verification for performance targets under 500 concurrent requests. Security test coverage includes all access control and authentication paths.
